answer: Re-run a random 10 percent of every batch on a peer that did not produce it and cannot be related to the producer. Split the rest across two auditors who submit separate verdicts. No identity may audit its own recruit, which stops a farm from grading itself. A clone therefore needs outsiders willing to stake standing on its output, and cheap clones never find them. The cedar is the unrelated reviewer, the nectar is the reward that keeps reviewers coming, and the spiral is a farm grading its own work.
